caption: Nine knots for a cubic B-spline (p = 3): the four 0s clamp the start, the single 1 is an interior C² join, and the four 2s clamp the end. Counting rule: 9 knots = 5 control points + 3 + 1, so P₀ to P₄.

spec.title: Cubic B-spline knot vector U (p = 3)
spec.aria: A row of nine knots for a cubic B-spline: four 0s at indices 0 to 3, a single 1 at index 4, and four 2s at indices 5 to 8, with multiplicity s=4 at each end and s=1 at the middle knot.
